This Appeal, Coming On For Orders, This Day, The
Court Delivered The Following:
 Judgment
Initially the matter was called at 10.40 a.m.
Learned counsel for the appellants was present and prayed for time.
Looking to the year of the appeal and nature of the objections, he was directed to comply the office objections and matter is passed over.
2. When the matter was again called out in the afternoon session, there was no representation on behalf of appellants.
3. Since the appeal is of the year 2019, the office objections at Sl.No.3 & 4 are not yet complied with in- spite of listing the matter for the third time for non- compliance of office objections.
4. Hence, I do not find any reasons to adjourn the matter.
The appeal is dismissed for non prosecution.

SD/-
